faq.question: How much does home cleaning cost?
faq.answer: The price depends on the surface area, the condition of the home and the frequency. It is confirmed in a quote, free and with no obligation.

faq.question: Which cities do you cover?
faq.answer: Douala and its surroundings. For another location, write to us: we look at every request.

faq.question: Can I book for a relative?
faq.answer: Yes. You make the request online or on WhatsApp, the housekeeper goes to your relative’s home and we keep you informed after every visit.

faq.question: Do I need to provide cleaning products?
faq.answer: No: the housekeeper brings the equipment and products. If you prefer your own, just mention it in your request.
